description.en: Sidq, falsifiability, declared limits and correctability.

grand.en: Four working principles, and one orientation stated openly.

lead.en: Sidq, falsifiability, declared limits and correctability. They come from MetaX Academy and apply to this whole site.

value.en: Truthfulness as an operative constraint: no page asserts more than its evidence supports; unknown figures are shown as unknown; a draft is never presented as a product.
Every substantive claim carries what would refute it.
Every body of work states what it does not cover.
Any reader can file a defect, and corrections are published with reasons.

body.en: The founder's orientation includes "God first, then human", and the Ontology Department aligns its work toward al-Ḥaqq, the Real. These are stated here so that readers can weigh the work knowing them. They are not claims that the five-dimensional ontology depends on them.

note.en: An earlier draft said "eleven"; the declaration lists seven.

text.en: A principle that cannot be checked is a slogan.
